title: nan
authors: Alnuaimi M.; Perhinschi M.G.; Al-Sinbol G.
key_contribution: Presents an artificial immune system (AIS) framework for correcting UAV position and velocity estimation errors during GNSS-denied autonomous flight, validated in simulation.
